title: El Paso, TX — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

El Paso is a city in TX with a population of 678,815. Sun City on the border with the most affordable housing in Texas and stunning desert views. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 297 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.1.
